glosses: Any member of the family Cactaceae, a family of flowering New World succulent plants suited to a hot, semi-desert climate.

examples.text: On the mountains a few junipers and piñons are found, and cactuses, agave, and yuccas, low, fleshy plants with bayonets and thorns.

Three years later, the unwatered cactus was still about two feet tall, a dark green color. The watered cactus was a paler green, its trunk visibly swollen with moisture. It had grown to be over five feet tall.

glosses: Any succulent plant with a thick fleshy stem bearing spines but no leaves, such as euphorbs.

Ce sont des plantes dites xérophytes qui stockent dans leurs tissus des réserves de suc pour faire face aux longues périodes de sécheresse. → voir Cactaceae

examples.text:

Dans le poudroîment d’or du pollen qu’elle lance,
